full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the opposite party no.10 Mrs. Ayesha Khatun Bibi instituted Other Class Suit no. 468 of 1977 in the Court of Munsif, Natore for partition of the suit land seeking a saham for 1.88 acres of land with a further declaration that the partition deed being no. 20913) dated 21.04.1975 of Rajshahi Sadar Sub-Registrar Office is collusive, fraudulent and not binding upon her contending inter-alia that 6.88 acres of land appertaining to C.S khatian no. no. 102 corresponding to S.A khatian no. 240 and R.S. Khatian 467 originally belonged to Jitu Prang who had two sons Pachan and Soleman. During the life time of Jitu Prang, his son Pachan died leaving daughter Ayesha Khatun Bibi. Jitu Prang died on 25e February, 1962 leaving son Soleman and daughter of pre-deceased son Pachan. In view of the provisions of Muslim Family Law Ordinance, 1961 Soleman and Ayesha Khatun Bibi had inherited equal share in the properties left by their predecessor Jitu Prang.
